name: gin
description_en: Gin is a high-performance HTTP web framework written in Go. It provides a Martini-like API but with significantly better performance—up to 40 times faster—thanks to httprouter. Gin is designed for building REST APIs, web applications, and microservices.
readme_excerpt: Gin Web Framework 📰 Gin 1.12.0 is now available! We're excited to announce the release of Gin 1.12.0! This release brings new features, performance improvements, and important bug fixes. Check out the release announcement on our official blog for the full details.
